title: Mushroom, Mascarpone and Pecorino Risotto
subtitle: with dried mushroom stock and chives
description: A creamy risotto built on dried mushroom stock, fresh button and portobello mushrooms, finished with mascarpone and pecorino.

steps.text: Combine the dried mushrooms and boiling water in a pot and keep covered.
Melt the butter in a large pan. Add the finely chopped onion and saute for about 5 minutes until soft. Add the wine and cook for about 2 minutes until it has evaporated.
Add the sliced fresh mushrooms and thyme sprigs and saute for about 5 minutes, stirring, until the mushrooms are soft.
Remove the dried mushrooms from the soaking liquid, chop roughly and add to the pan.
Add the rice and a ladle of the mushroom stock, season with salt and pepper, and cook, stirring, until the liquid is absorbed.
Keep adding hot stock gradually until the rice is al dente (about 20 minutes). The rice may be ready before the stock runs out.
Add the mascarpone and pecorino and cook for another minute, stirring, until melted. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Sprinkle with finely chopped chives and serve immediately.
